summary: Heller myotomy in achalasia with a 5.2 cm debris filled esophagus despite 48 h of clears, regurgitation at 0200, a prior aspiration pneumonia, and regurgitation with desaturation during MAC in 2025.

asa.rationale: Severe achalasia with prior aspiration pneumonia and malnutrition.

decision.recommendation: proceed with an aspiration focused plan
decision.rationale: Fasting does not empty this esophagus. RSI in a head up position with large bore suction, no blind gastric tubes, and coordination with the surgeon for intraop EGD and bougie.

redFlags.finding: Retained esophageal contents despite prolonged clear diet
redFlags.evidence: Esophagram 09/2026: 5.2 cm with food debris after liquids only; regurgitated broth and jello at 0200; aspiration pneumonia 01/2026; MAC 07/2025 regurgitation with SpO2 86%; anesthesia recommended RSI.
redFlags.action: RSI head up 30 to 45 degrees, suction immediately available, consider awake intubation if extreme; avoid MAC.

redFlags.finding: No OG or NG until the surgeon requests; intraop EGD and bougie
redFlags.implication: Perforation risk at the myotomy; coordinated passage.
redFlags.action: Pass tubes only under surgeon direction; communicate during EGD leak test.

redFlags.finding: Vomiting must be prevented after fundoplication
Childhood penicillin hives with clindamycin ordered
redFlags.implication: Cefazolin is usually acceptable per current allergy guidance.

planItems.item: RSI head up with rocuronium or succinylcholine
